item.title: [6.9] Envisioning Agentic Robotics: A New Era of Robotic Systems
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

The release of GPT-6 Astra marks the emergence of a new paradigm in robotics: agentic robotics. Within weeks, frontier models with agentic harnesses matched or exceeded task-specific policies on many embodied benchmarks. Instead of training a dedicated policy for each family of tasks, an agentic robotic system applies a foundation model to open-world embodied tasks.

WHY IT MATTERS

This paper provides a timely conceptual framework for the shift toward foundation-model-driven agentic robotics, though it largely synthesizes current industry trends rather than presenting empirical breakthroughs.

item.title: [6.6] Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agent
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

We introduce Gamer, a generalist agent framework built for long-horizon tasks in complex interactive environments. Its end-to-end architecture combines perception, memory management, and multi-step reasoning. A shared training and deployment pipeline supports interaction with both conventional 2D graphical interfaces and complex 3D simulated worlds.

WHY IT MATTERS

Gamer introduces a unified vision-language-action model tackling long-horizon tasks across both 2D and 3D interactive environments using sparse-thinking and stable multi-turn RL.

item.description:

Indian government bonds have taken a hit, driven by increased selling pressures and fears of imminent interest rate hikes.
